pins.note: Manually reviewed 3 November site snapshot. Its specification, extension, guides and changelog text matches upstream commit 7205250 (2 November) apart from site formatting: code-block titles, heading anchors and link prefixes. Since the 29 October pin: Companies without an OAuth issuer (850a46d), auth.disabled, extension content in messages, session_ended, poppy_dlg and poppy-delegation+jwt, and the Links, Disclosures and UCP extensions. Snapshot hashes are the exact pin. 0.3 was published on 4 November 2026 with this text and is frozen: its pages and changelog entries were unchanged on 9 November, so drift checks only its own pages and changelog entry titles.

Manually reviewed 11 November site snapshot: 0.4 as published on 10 November (upstream 4803900, then ed47408 dropping "draft" from the text) as the 1.0 release candidate, replacing the 10 November draft pin (a2f16ec). Since then: Operations can decline an approval, Direct Sign-In opened on another device is a cross-device flow (10.8), the protected resource metadata may list scopes_supported, the browser-session endpoint may be on another host, and guides on scopes a Company doesn't grant and passkeys on consent pages; the 38 earlier changelog entries keep their titles. The pinned kit is upstream kit/company at ed47408 apart from links the site rewrites to /docs/0.4/, and its reference pages match this snapshot. The home page walkthroughs were not extracted: the snapshot script can not read the new bundle; they are examples, not requirements. 0.4 is now frozen; fixes before 1.0 go into a draft 1.0, which would get its own pin.
